motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council instruct the Department of City Planning and the Department of Transportation, with the assistance of the Department of Building and Safety and the Police Department, and in consultation with the City Attorney, to prepare a report with recommendations on the feasibility and legal authority to require ingress and egress for the properties located at 1502 East Lomita Boulevard, 1600 East Lomita Boulevard, and 1612 North Blinn Avenue in Wilmington, CA 90744 (APNs 7426027018, 7426027019, and 7426027020) be limited to the north end of the site as part of ongoing nuisance abatement efforts. I FURTHER MOVE that the Council instruct the Planning Department, with the assistance of the various departments, to include recommendations in the requested report that identify any necessary land use approvals, code enforcement actions, property improvements, environmental review, legal authorities, or other measures needed to implement the proposed ingress and egress configuration, and provide a potential timeline for implementation. The report should also include, as appropriate, any information, data, or supplemental background being gathered as part of the pending nuisance abatement report previously instructed by the Council under Motion (McOsker-Hutt), CF 26-0171. PRESENTED BY: LM TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District 3 2 , 2026 SECONDED BY:/HOMaol
title: 1502 East Lomita Boulevard / 1600 East Lomita Boulevard / 1612 North Blinn Avenue / Feasibility and Legal Authority / Ingress and Egress
